shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张空白作业许可证，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank work permit form and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 作业许可十问，听完选项马上揭晓答案。
overlay: 作业许可十问：何时办、谁检查、何时停

shots.scene: 一行图标：许可证、焊枪、监火人、泵区
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a permit form, a welding torch, a fire watch person and a pump area. No people.
shots.narration: 何时办、谁检查、何时停，都在题里。

shots.scene: 厂区泵房外，老李拿着焊接工具
shots.prompt_en: Outside a plant pump house, the facility engineer holds welding tools.
shots.narration: 老李要在泵房旁焊一个支架。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白许可证走来
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks over holding a blank permit form.
shots.narration: 王老师说：先来答十道许可题。

shots.section_title: 边听边测：题后即给答案
shots.scene: 老李头上一个思考气泡，旁边计时沙漏
shots.prompt_en: A thought bubble above the facility engineer's head, with an hourglass beside him.
shots.narration: 每题先自己想，答案紧跟着就给。
overlay: 边听边测：题后即给答案

shots.section_title: 为什么用作业许可制度
shots.scene: 许可证图标旁四个选项卡
shots.prompt_en: A permit icon with four option cards. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：为什么要用作业许可制度？
overlay: 为什么用作业许可制度

shots.section_title: 为什么用作业许可制度
shots.scene: 限制区、安全作业、控制措施三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a restricted area fence, a safe worker and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 控制限制区作业、安全防意外、落实措施。

shots.section_title: 为什么用作业许可制度
shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，以上都是。

shots.section_title: 许可证写的是最低措施
shots.scene: 许可证上一列安全条目
shots.prompt_en: A permit form with a list of blank safety lines. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：许可证里和安全有关的是什么？
overlay: 许可证写的是最低措施

shots.section_title: 许可证写的是最低措施
shots.scene: 四张选项卡片
shots.prompt_en: Four blank option cards with icons: a law book, a government building, a shield and a checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 美国标准的法定要求、监管机构要求，

shots.section_title: 许可证写的是最低措施
shots.scene: 四张卡片轮流亮起
shots.prompt_en: The four cards light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 控制风险的最低措施，还是通用清单？

shots.section_title: 许可证写的是最低措施
shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，控制风险的最低安全措施。

shots.scene: 扫帚图标和许可证打问号
shots.prompt_en: A broom icon and a permit form with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：哪种低风险作业可不办许可？

shots.scene: 射线、焊枪、扫帚、管道试压四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a radiation symbol, a welding torch, a broom and a pressure gauge on a pipe. No people.
shots.narration: 射线探伤、动火、清扫、管道试压。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，清洁和清扫。

shots.scene: 靶心图标和许可证
shots.prompt_en: A target icon next to a permit form. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：许可制度的主要目标是？

shots.scene: 公司政策、审核记录、防事故、调查数据
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a policy book, an audit folder, a shield and a chart. No people.
shots.narration: 守公司政策、留审核记录、防事故、出数据。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，防止事故。

shots.section_title: 签发动火许可前查三样
shots.scene: 焊接火花和空白动火许可证
shots.prompt_en: Welding sparks next to a blank hot work permit form. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：签发动火许可前，签发人查什么？
overlay: 签发动火许可前查三样

shots.section_title: 签发动火许可前查三样
shots.scene: 签名、措施落实、监火人三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a signature, a checked shield and a fire watch person with an extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 接收人签字、措施落实、监火人在场。

shots.section_title: 签发动火许可前查三样
shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，以上都是。

shots.scene: 两人在现场指着设备讨论
shots.prompt_en: Two person icons discuss equipment at the work site. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：联合检查时签发人讨论什么？

shots.scene: 四张选项卡片
shots.prompt_en: Four blank option cards with icons: a rule book, a crane certificate, a scope chart and a fire watch badge. No people.
shots.narration: 法规要求、设备证书、范围设备、监火人。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，工作范围、设备和特殊条件。

shots.scene: 围栏圈起的区域打问号
shots.prompt_en: A fenced area with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：哪个可能是限制区？

shots.scene: 机修车间、预制场、化学品实验室、泵区
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a machine shop, a remote fabrication yard, a chemistry lab and a pump area with a flame symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 机修车间、预制场、化学品实验室、泵区。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，处理易燃物料的泵区。

shots.scene: 许可证上一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A permit form with a question mark over it. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：什么条件下可以不办许可？

shots.scene: 低风险、时间短、花钱少三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a low risk tag, a short clock and a small coin. No people.
shots.narration: 低风险、时间短、花钱少，还是都不是？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，低风险作业。

shots.scene: 许可证被撕开的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a permit form being torn in half. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：许可证在什么情况下取消？

shots.scene: 违规、紧急、恶劣天气三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a rule-breaking mark, an alarm bell and a storm cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 违反许可条件、紧急情况、恶劣天气。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，以上都是。

shots.scene: 两个人形图标走向现场
shots.prompt_en: Two person icons walk toward a work site. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：签发前谁做联合现场检查？

shots.scene: 四组人形图标
shots.prompt_en: Four pairs of person icons. No people.
shots.narration: 工人和接收人？签发人和接收人？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，签发人和接收人。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 许可证防事故，写的是最低安全措施。

shots.scene: 扫帚图标和泵区图标
shots.prompt_en: A broom icon next to a pump area icon. No people.
shots.narration: 清扫是低风险，易燃泵区是限制区。

shots.scene: 焊花、监火人、两人检查图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of welding sparks, a fire watch person and two people inspecting. No people.
shots.narration: 动火前查三样，签发人接收人一起查。

shots.scene: 撕开的许可证和雨云图标
shots.prompt_en: A torn permit icon next to a storm cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 违规、紧急、恶劣天气，许可证就取消。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起许可证挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up the permit form and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 作业许可十问到这里，下次见！
